title: Zen Browser profiles
whyItMatters: Each Zen profile holds history, cookies, saved logins, extensions and workspaces. A profile on this PC shows the browser was used and how many separate identities were kept.
source: Zen Browser documentation, FAQ: Windows profiles at %APPDATA%/zen/Profiles - https://docs.zen-browser.app/faq
notes: Matches the prefs.js marker so only real profiles are counted. Profile names are random per install. Firefox and other forks use different profile roots.

cleanup.exportFirst: In Zen, export bookmarks to an HTML file and save any passwords you need from the browser's password settings.
cleanup.signOut: Sign out of Mozilla Sync in Zen settings, or disconnect this profile from the account, so the account no longer trusts this browser.
steps: Uninstall Zen Browser from Settings > Apps > Installed apps.
Delete the Zen profile folder named in the plan if it is still there.
cleanup.risk: Removes every Zen profile on this PC: history, bookmarks, cookies, saved logins and workspaces.
